about_the_game:
Victory Banner is a dynamic real-time strategy game that lets you take direct control of any unit — from infantry to tanks! Immerse yourself in the various stages of one of humanity's most significant conflicts, focusing on the events of 1941 on the Eastern Front.

Add the game to your Wishlist and subscribe for updates!

Key Features:

  • High-paced сombat: Experience fast and intense interactions on the battlefield, where every moment can be crucial.

  • Instant switching between RTS and action control: Command an entire squad or individual units, directly influencing the outcome of battles.

  • All mechanics available in both modes: Move freely, shoot, take cover, and manage inventory in both strategic and action modes. Quickly switch between fighters to respond effectively to battlefield changes and issue commands without delay.

  • Detailed targeting mechanics for special units: Enjoy unique targeting mechanics for various unit types—from snipers to mortars and Maxim machine guns. Control vehicles like tanks with precision, adding depth to your gameplay.

  • Multiple single-player modes for engaging gameplay: Dive into well-crafted historical scenario missions. For example:

    - Frontline: Defend and capture control points.

    - Stealth: Capture control points with a small squad against larger enemy forces on their territory.

    - Detailed maps for each mode: Explore recognizable environments from the Eastern Front and other historical locations.

Feel Like a Strategist

Explore and assess terrain, capture buildings, navigate streets and other locations, throw grenades, set mines, and use various fortifications for defense and capture: trenches, bunkers, sandbags, urban objects, and other map elements to stop the enemy.

Build fortifications using an engineering truck and manage each soldier's inventory. These mechanics will allow you to adapt to changing battlefield conditions.

Use aviation for aerial reconnaissance and artillery or ground attack aircraft for strikes on target points to turn the tide of battle at critical moments.

Fight on the Frontline

You can instantly switch between commanding an entire company or controlling individual soldiers or vehicles. Take charge: make a key sniper shot, break through enemy defenses with a T-34, use a medkit to bring important fighters back into action.

This mode offers fine control over gameplay details for each unit: change aiming shoulders, pick up weapons on the battlefield, reload firearms, throw grenades, set mines, interact with sniper rifles, and use powerful armaments like machine guns and mortars.

Every action you take can have a decisive impact on the battle's outcome.

Refined targeting modes for special units:

  • Snipers

  • Submachine gunners (PPSh)

  • Maxim machine gunners

  • Vehicles (including T-34 and T-38 tanks)

  • BM-37 mortars

  • Light machine guns

  • And more!

The third-person control mode offers complete immersion in dynamic combat actions where every moment demands quick reactions and strategic thinking.

Defend your homeland, win battles, and become part of history — where each mission is a new chapter of heroism and courage from ordinary people.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64bit - Windows 10
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1050 / RX 5600
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: SSD drive for optimal gameplay
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64bit - Windows 10
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2060 / RX 6600
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound Compatible Sound Card with latest drivers
  • Additional Notes: SSD drive for optimal gameplay

short_description: Dive into the early events of World War II with this dynamic real-time historical strategy game. Take command of an entire company or directly control individual soldiers and ground vehicles. Make decisions that could change the course of the war.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Turkish
